requiredNativeSequence: Authorized release source commit must be reachable in internal Gitea on a host-allowed branch.
SKOPOS signs BuildOrder; the shared node agent builds via its fixed recipe, runs component tests and full candidate quality, and journals the immutable image.
MOMUS validates candidate evidence and signs a FixVerdict bound to the immutable image.
SKOPOS signs DeployOrder; the shared node agent checks the signed chain, build journal and latest candidate receipt.
